scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed ~25-26 cm per side; food covers roughly 55-60% of the plate surface in a mostly single layer; broccoli floret size (~5-6 cm) and pork medallion diameter (~4-5 cm) used as secondary cues. No cutlery or hand visible.
assumptions: Plate is a standard ~25 cm square dinner plate
Sliced meat is pork tenderloin (could be chicken thigh or turkey); identified by pale grey-brown colour and round medallion shape
Thin golden strip at the bottom edge is a breaded chicken strip (could be breaded fish)
Salad greens appear lightly dressed with an oil-based vinaigrette judging by their sheen; amount is uncertain
White pieces in the salad are cauliflower, not cheese or egg
Broccoli is steamed with no visible added butter or oil
Small yellow fleck on the meat and red/orange flecks in the salad are minor garnishes (carrot, onion, dried cranberry) under ~10 g total
